column1: # KOGANE companion (ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8) — custom partition table.
# Why this file exists: the app outgrew the stock single-app layout. At 872
# bytes against the default 1 MB `factory` partition the image was 83% full
# the esp32-camera driver plus esp_http_server push it further. The module has
# 16 MB of flash (CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHSIZE_16MB=y) and the stock table used
# barely 3 MB of it
column2: so the app gets 3 MB and the headroom problem goes away.

column1: # Layout (partition table itself lives at 0x8000
#   offset     size            name       notes
#   0x000000   0x008000 (32K)  —          2nd stage bootloader
#   0x008000   0x001000 (4K)   —          this partition table
#   0x009000   0x006000 (24K)  nvs        UNMOVED from the stock layout
#   0x00f000   0x001000 (4K)   phy_init   UNMOVED from the stock layout
#   0x310000   —               unallocated (~12.9 MB free to the end of flash)
# `nvs` and `phy_init` keep their stock offsets AND their stock sizes on purpose.
# Only the app partition grew
# calibration and PHY data already in flash stay where the new table says they
# are and survive the reflash. Had nvs moved
# would have found an unformatted region and re-initialised it (app_main already
# handles ESP_ERR_NVS_NO_FREE_PAGES)
# Alignment: app partitions must start on a 64 KB (0x10000) boundary. `factory`
# starts at 0x10000 and is 0x300000 long
# free offset (0x310000) is also 64 KB aligned and a future app-type partition
# can be added there without shuffling anything.
# Single `factory` app
